title: NYC Airbnb Price Prediction — Kaggle Competition
prompt: Create a 4:3 cover image for "NYC Airbnb Price Intelligence", a machine learning project that predicts NYC Airbnb nightly prices. Show a stylized NYC borough and street-grid map transformed into a pricing intelligence dashboard: neighborhood clusters, listing-card fragments, price bands, geospatial dots, a prediction curve with confidence interval, feature-signal chips for location, amenities, reviews, and text features, and three model layers merging into one final prediction. The mood should be urban, analytical, product-ready, and practical. Use deep urban navy, concrete gray, warm apartment-window amber, muted model green, and off-white interface surfaces. Make it feel like a real pricing data product, not a generic AI poster. Minimal readable text is allowed: "NYC Airbnb Price Intelligence", "Pricing / Geospatial / NLP", "Predict - Explain - Compare". Avoid official Airbnb branding, exact platform UI, Kaggle trophies, AI brains, and tiny unreadable labels.

title: Warming Unevenly — DSC 106 Project 3
prompt: Create a 4:3 cover image for "Warming Unevenly", an interactive climate data visualization about regional warming differences under CMIP6 scenarios. Show a designed climate anomaly map with regions warming at visibly different rates, an emphasized Arctic/polar region showing polar amplification, side-by-side scenario comparison bands, a subtle year-slider cue, a trend line, and a small regional ranking panel. The image should feel like a climate-science visualization interface, not a generic Earth wallpaper. Use cool ocean blues and pale cyan for baseline areas, thermal orange/coral/deep red for stronger anomalies, and a restrained violet accent for extreme polar amplification. Minimal readable text is allowed: "Warming Unevenly", "CMIP6 Scenarios", "Scenario - Compare - Explore". Avoid burning planet imagery, disaster-photo aesthetics, official institutional marks, and unreadable tiny labels.
